scripts.db:migrate: npx sequelize-cli db:migrate --env development --config src/config/db.js --migrations-path src/migrations
scripts.db:migrate:undo: npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo --env development --config src/config/db.js --migrations-path src/migrations
scripts.db:seed: npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all --env development --config src/config/db.js --seeders-path src/seeders
scripts.db:seed:undo: npx sequelize-cli db:seed:undo:all --env development --config src/config/db.js --seeders-path src/seeders
